conjectures.statement: Peak Viscous Non-Amplification Theorem: For any smooth solution of 3D incompressible Navier-Stokes, at any spatial maximum x*(t) of |omega|, the viscous rate satisfies V_log(x*, t) <= -nu ||grad(omega_hat)||_F^2 <= 0. Consequently, maximum vorticity growth is governed purely by vortex stretching: D ln ||omega||_infty / Dt <= lambda_omega(x*, t) <= lambda_3(x*, t).
conjectures.proof_sketch: Follows from Delta(|omega|) <= 0 at spatial maxima and ||grad(xi)||_F^2 >= 0.
